
Two arXiv papers from the RSS feed meet the inclusion threshold. Orchestra-o1 addresses omnimodal agent orchestration architecture directly. WorkBench Revisited offers longitudinal empirical grounding on workplace agents in production. Grok social signals were largely synthetic/hallucinated URLs and were discarded. Other arXiv entries were too narrow, safety-only, or insufficiently agentic-workflow-focused.

## Suggestions

- [Orchestra-o1: Omnimodal Agent Orchestration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.13707) — Presents an omnimodal agent orchestration architecture addressing multi-modal tool use, agent coordination patterns, and execution design across the agent lifecycle.
  Section: Research Papers | Criteria: Architectural guidance for goal-directed agent systems (patterns, orchestration, state management), Tool-use and execution design across agent lifecycle stages (planning, execution, feedback, recovery), Empirical or practical grounding (case studies, benchmarks, production deployment evidence)

- [WorkBench Revisited: Workplace Agents Two Years On](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.13715) — Longitudinal reassessment of workplace agentic systems two years after initial deployment, providing empirical grounding on production reliability, evaluation loops, and agent workflow design in real-world settings.
  Section: Research Papers | Criteria: Architectural guidance for goal-directed agent systems (patterns, orchestration, state management), Iterative refinement practices (evaluation loops, human-in-the-loop, observability), Empirical or practical grounding (case studies, benchmarks, production deployment evidence)
